document.credit: An adapted edition of Alpöge, Buckmaster and Coiculescu's paper, prepared by Will Cook with AI assistance. The mathematics and the original text are the authors'. Every change is marked, and no change has been reviewed by the authors.

notes: The revision follows the shear from one wave to the next and explains how the pressure bound enters the endpoint correction.
The final estimates distinguish growth at launch times from control between launches. Appendix A identifies the real Hilbert space used for the endpoint inverse.
